anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: I am the first and the last and the beginning and the end.
Quoted: The Lord created me a beginning of his ways.

pass_a_gloss: And as it was shown that of the first there is necessity that the beginning also be, accordingly here to the being-first he says also to be beginning: For I am, he says, the first and last and the beginning and the end. For in that he is firstborn of all creation he is first, and in that he is Wisdom, beginning; for so says the Wisdom through Solomon, that the Lord created me beginning of his ways.
pass_b_english: And as it has been shown that of the first there must also be the beginning, he accordingly says here, because he is first, that he is also beginning: For I am, he says, the first and the last and the beginning and the end. For insofar as he is firstborn of all creation, he is first; and insofar as he is Wisdom, he is beginning. For so says Wisdom through Solomon, that "The Lord created me a beginning of his ways." (Revelation 22:13) (Colossians 1:15) (Proverbs 8:22)
source_text: Ὡς δὲ ἐδείχθη ὅτι τ[οῦ πρ]ώτου ἀνάγκη καὶ τ[ὴν ἀρ]χὴν εἶναι, ἀκολούθως ἐνθάδε τῷ πρῶτος εἶναι λέγει καὶ ἀρχὴ εἶναι· Ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι, φησίν, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ἔσχατος καὶ ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος. Ἦ γὰρ πρωτότοκός ἐστιν πάσης κτίσεως, πρῶτός|| ἐστιν, καὶ ᾗ σοφία ἐστίν, ἀρχή· [οὕτως γάρ φησιν ἡ σοφία διὰ τοῦ Σαλομῶντος, ὅτι "Κ(ύριο)ς ἔκτισέν με ἀρχ[ὴ]ν ὁδῶν αὐτοῦ".
